title: Trustworthy AI literature themes
goal: Show major research themes for a literature review on trustworthy AI.

rubric.must: Trustworthy AI Literature Themes is visibly the central root topic.
Fairness, Transparency, Safety, and Governance visibly branch from the root.
Fairness and Transparency visibly expand to measurement or mitigation and interpretability or documentation leaves.
Safety and Governance visibly expand to robustness or evaluation and accountability or regulation leaves.
Concrete leaves such as group metrics, model cards, red-team testing, and risk classification are readable.
At least three visual hierarchy levels are distinguishable.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the mindmap/map exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The target shows “Trustworthy AI Literature Themes” as the central root, with all four themes and their subtopics and concrete leaves visibly connected. Labels are readable, the three-level hierarchy is clear, and no material overlap or cropping is apparent.

items.evidence: “Trustworthy AI Literature Themes” is visibly centered in the root node.
Fairness, Transparency, Safety, and Governance each visibly branch from the root.

Fairness branches to Measurement and Mitigation, with “Group and individual metrics” and “Pre-processing and constraints”; Transparency branches to Interpretability and Documentation, with “Feature attribution” and “Model cards and data sheets.”
Safety branches to Robustness and Evaluation, with “Distribution shift” and “Red-team testing”; Governance branches to Accountability and Regulation, with “Human oversight” and “Risk classification.”
Concrete leaf labels including “Group and individual metrics,” “Model cards and data sheets,” “Red-team testing,” and “Risk classification” are readable.
The root, colored theme nodes, intermediate topic labels, and concrete leaf labels are visually distinguishable as successive hierarchy levels.
